context_summary: The paper presents a system to predict and explain mobile UI tappability using vision modeling and saliency analysis. It includes a dataset of crowdworkers' tappability labels and an exploratory evaluation with professional designers.
exclusion_facts: The paper does not collect human subjective evaluations directly; it relies on existing datasets and user studies.
